spec_features.spec_quote: loop_break — degenerate repetition detected (same tool call ≥ K=6 times in a row with identical args) → auto-terminate to save budget
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:126-132 builds a signature of the turn's tool calls and increments repeat_count when sig==last_sig; runner.py:154-157 'if repeat_count + 1 >= loop_cfg.loop_break_repeat_k: reason = "loop_break"; logger.log_termination(...); break'. loop_break_repeat_k default=6 (runner.py:32, experiment.yaml:11). repeat_count+1>=6 means 6 identical consecutive signatures → actually breaks the agentic loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: signature compared each turn and break is reached when the threshold is hit. Triggers only on identical consecutive tool-call signatures (matches the claim).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop_break_repeat_k: 6  # identical consecutive tool call -> auto terminate (experiment.yaml:11); code comment 'Degenerate-repetition detection' (runner.py:126)

spec_features.evidence: runner.py:103 'for turn in range(1, loop_cfg.max_turns + 1):' bounds the agentic loop; the for/else at runner.py:158-159 logs termination 'max_turns' and reason defaults to 'max_turns' (runner.py:97). max_turns default=40 (runner.py:29, experiment.yaml:8).
spec_features.notes: The loop bound is real and ends the run; the value 40 is the default actually read by the loop. No top-level orchestrator (run_experiment.py absent) but run_one reads loop_cfg.max_turns directly so the cap is enforced whenever run_one executes.

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py:61 defines a 'finish' tool; runner.py:148-150 'if tc.name == "finish": finished = True; reason = ...'; runner.py:152-153 'if finished: break' actually terminates the loop. This lets the subject declare done/giving up and stops further pressure.
